packageRules.description: Formula/tresor.rb is generated by scripts/sync-packaging.sh from the release assets (version + per-arch sha256). Renovate's homebrew manager rewrote only the Apple-Silicon entry to a source tarball while leaving `version` and the other three URLs behind, and merging its stale PR reverted the generated file. Do not manage it here.
The ratatui ecosystem must move together: ratatui-textarea tracks ratatui-core, which ratatui re-exports.
Dependency upgrades need review: the Vault client depends on specific reqwest feature names and response shapes.
Major version bumps are breaking by definition and must not land unattended.
